scripts.start:server: node init && cd server && node index.js
scripts.start:client: node init && cd client && npm run dev
scripts.dev: node init && npx concurrently "npm run start:server" "npm run start:client"
scripts.build: node init && cd client && npm run build
scripts.start: node init && npm run build && npm run start:server
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && cd ../ai_service && pip3 install -r requirements.txt
